description:
Sold off to settle her uncle's debts, Edith is dragged into the treacherous Portrion estate as the comatose viscount’s fourth wife. Now at the mercy of the greedy first wife, Edith is given a ruthless ultimatum: conceive an heir within a month, by any man and any means possible. To survive and escape the lethal estate, Edith strikes a bargain with Walter, an enigmatic stablehand who is shackled as much as she is. However, as the two of them feign an affair while seeking their freedom, they eventually stumble across the line between fake passion and true feelings…
